researcher.title: Researcher
researcher.description: Researchers explore the unknown, formulate hypotheses, and build rigorous theoretical models. They excel in deep and independent analysis.
researcher.why_fit: Strong Introverted Thinking (Ti) or Introverted Intuition (Ni) allows them to grasp invisible patterns and maintain the logical rigor needed for long-term research.

project_manager.title: Project Manager
project_manager.description: Project managers coordinate resources, deadlines, and people to complete complex initiatives, balancing empathy and efficiency.
project_manager.why_fit: Extraverted Thinking (Te) provides structure and planning, while Extraverted Feeling (Fe) helps navigate team dynamics.

software_engineer.title: Software Engineer
software_engineer.description: Software engineers solve complex logical problems by writing maintainable and efficient code.
software_engineer.why_fit: Structured analysis (Ti/Te) combined with imagination for systemic architectures (Ni) fosters the precision needed in software development.

designer_ux.title: UX Designer
designer_ux.description: UX designers create intuitive and empathetic user experiences, combining creativity, visual logic, and human understanding.
designer_ux.why_fit: Empathy for the end-user (Fi/Fe) along with exploring possibilities (Ne/Ni) allows them to create innovative and human-centric solutions.

product_manager.title: Product Manager
product_manager.description: Product managers guide the vision of a product, interpreting market needs and coordinating teams to realize them.
product_manager.why_fit: Extraverted Intuition (Ne) captures market opportunities, while Extraverted Thinking (Te) ensures the product is delivered.

sales.title: Sales Professional
sales.description: Sales professionals build relationships, understand customer needs, and negotiate mutually beneficial agreements.
sales.why_fit: Extraverted Feeling (Fe) allows for instant rapport, and Extraverted Sensing (Se) ensures responsiveness in the present moment.

therapist.title: Therapist / Psychologist
therapist.description: Therapists guide people through emotional and psychological healing journeys, offering deep listening and support.
therapist.why_fit: Introverted Feeling (Fi) and Intuition (Ni/Ne) offer an incredible ability to empathize and understand others' inner dynamics.

teacher.title: Teacher
teacher.description: Teachers impart knowledge, inspire students, and create a structured and welcoming learning environment.
teacher.why_fit: Extraverted Feeling (Fe) creates a harmonious classroom, while Introverted Sensing (Si) maintains order and respect for educational programs.

surgeon.title: Surgeon
surgeon.description: Surgeons operate in high-pressure environments, requiring pinpoint precision, steady nerves, and quick decisions.
surgeon.why_fit: Extraverted Sensing (Se) guarantees excellent hand-eye coordination, supported by cold logical analysis (Ti/Te).

journalist.title: Journalist
journalist.description: Journalists investigate, interview, and tell stories, moving quickly to capture information as it happens.
journalist.why_fit: Extraverted Intuition (Ne) sees the connections between events, while Extraverted Sensing (Se) keeps them grounded in reality.

entrepreneur.title: Entrepreneur
entrepreneur.description: Entrepreneurs start new businesses, taking the necessary risks to turn an innovative vision into a real business.
entrepreneur.why_fit: Action orientation (Te/Se) joins with the vision of future potential (Ne/Ni), constantly pushing innovation forward.

accountant.title: Accountant
accountant.description: Accountants ensure financial accuracy, regulatory compliance, and proper bookkeeping.
accountant.why_fit: Introverted Sensing (Si) provides extreme attention to historical details, combined with the rigor of Thinking (Te/Ti).

social_worker.title: Social Worker
social_worker.description: Social workers intervene in situations of need, offering practical and emotional support to vulnerable individuals and families.
social_worker.why_fit: Deep empathy (Fe/Fi) and a strong practical sense allow them to face daily crises with compassion and determination.

data_analyst.title: Data Analyst
data_analyst.description: Data analysts extract meaning from huge amounts of data, providing logical insights to drive business decisions.
data_analyst.why_fit: Deep logical inquiry (Ti) and procedural efficiency (Te), supported by data order (Si/Ni), are fundamental.

creative_director.title: Creative Director
creative_director.description: Creative directors guide the artistic vision of campaigns, brands, or products, coordinating diverse talents towards a single aesthetic.
creative_director.why_fit: Intuition (Ne/Ni) generates visual or conceptual inspiration, supported by Feeling (Fi/Fe) to capture the audience's emotion.

operations_manager.title: Operations Manager
operations_manager.description: Operations managers optimize daily processes, ensuring that company resources are used with maximum efficiency.
operations_manager.why_fit: Extraverted Thinking (Te) and Sensing (Si/Se) are essential to keep the logistical system fluid and responsive to problems.
